detail.longDescription: An autonomous pentest agent first hit the API of WorkOS's internal sales tool on Oct 25. It was caught Oct 30, by an employee noticing unusually high usage, after the bulk retrieval had ended. The way in: a local-dev credential left in production, on an API with no rate limit. Alerts on request volume are still on WorkOS's in-progress fix list. https:// workos.com/security/bulletins/ update-for-october-30th-2026-data-security-incident # Cybersecurity # AIAgents # DevOps
